svg.title: charter-replay: diff two guard hooks over a pinned corpus (animated)
svg.desc: Animated loop with illustrative toy-guard commands: recorded commands from a pinned corpus run through the baseline and candidate PreToolUse hooks, decisions are compared, one command is newly allowed and one becomes indeterminate after a timeout, the default fail-on rule exits 1, and only a counts-only aggregate is published. It re-evaluates recorded decisions and is not a sandbox.
svg.text: re-evaluates recorded command events · not the original agent, shell or OS boundary · not a sandbox
each hook: shell-free argv · PreToolUse JSON on stdin · fresh workspace per command

g.text: counts only: no commands, no paths

svg.text: Recorded commands from a pinned corpus replay through both hooks
v2 lets a reworded rm -rf through: newly allowed
A force-push is newly blocked, and a timeout is indeterminate, not a pass
The decisions are bucketed by change
For private corpora, only counts are published
